description: Generate a pre-filled direct cart checkout link for magsnap.co.za so the customer can upload their photos and complete payment via PayFast. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'create_checkout_link' on MagSnap Custom Photo Magnets (magsnap.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_products' or 'calculate_quote' or 'track_order' for their respective operations). Parameters: single_magnet_count (optional), ai_styled_count (optional), puzzle_set_count (optional), is_gift (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Creates a live record/session in the backend database; no authentication required for public initiation; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

ai_styled_count.description: Number of magnets with 3D Pixar/cartoon AI styling. [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

is_gift.description: Whether to enable gift packaging (+R50). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

puzzle_set_count.description: Number of 9-piece puzzle magnet sets (R270 each). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

single_magnet_count.description: Number of standard custom square photo magnets (R30 each). [Optional: omit to use server default filter].

name: create_checkout_link
title: Create Checkout Link
